note: The two sets are nearly identical in coverage and accuracy, both capturing the filter characteristics, the five control-region laws, and the key numeric ratings with supporting quotes. A's only flaw is that it states the Region 3 inverse-proportionality fact twice under slightly different condition wording, while B attaches an unsupported 'Region 3' condition to the rated generator speed of 1173.7 rpm, which the text gives as a general rating input rather than a Region 3 condition. Because B adds a condition the page does not support and A's defect is mere redundancy, A is marginally better.
remarks: Both sets miss the stated purpose of Region 1½ (placing a lower limit on generator speed to limit the turbine's operational speed range) and of Region 2½ (needed to limit tip speed and noise emissions at rated power), and neither notes that the 670 rpm minimum generator speed corresponds to the 6.9 rpm minimum rotor speed. The 'conditions: time domain' on the -6 dB/octave roll-off claim is carried over from a preceding sentence and is not really a condition of the roll-off figure; both sets share this quirk.
